verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a paid plan that includes unlimited users, remote access and automations. It does not document an enterprise tier, SSO, or commercial support. The OAuth 2.1/API-key auth is for API and MCP access, not organizational SSO, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can license an enterprise deployment with SSO and commercial support for organization-wide rollout
